flags.description: Coop and Migros together account for roughly 80% of Swiss grocery retail sales; Swiss consumer-protection group Konsumentenschutz has publicly called on the competition commission (WEKO) to act against the pair over high margins and large price gaps on organic food.

Coop's Naturaplan is Switzerland's largest organic label, offering over 2,500 Bio Suisse certified products since its launch in 1993, covering food, beverages, and household goods with independently audited organic and sustainability standards.

Coop's Naturafarm label sets stricter animal welfare standards than Swiss law requires for pork, poultry, and veal, including mandatory outdoor access, group housing, and restrictions on routine antibiotic use; producers receive premium pricing for compliance.
